item.title: Taoiseach to visit areas worst affected by Storm Chandra
item.description: Taoiseach Micheál Martin will today visit areas worst affected by last week's floods. Several counties across the south and east are continuing clean-up efforts following Storm Chandra. Meanwhile, another status yellow rain warning for Wexford, Carlow, Kilkenny, Waterford and Cork will come into effect at 6 o'clock this evening. item.title: Local TD reveals government plans to boost investment in apprenticeships
item.description: A local TD has revealed the government plans to increase investment in apprenticeships. Sligo-Leitrim TD Marian Harkin said that the current funding for apprenticeships has more than doubled since Budget 2020. On traineeships, she notes that SOLAS funds ETBs based on local demand, supporting over 75 traineeship programmes nationwide across many sectors. The Independent Ireland TD says apprenticeships and traineeships are a key part of Ireland’s education system: Advertisement

item.title: Tributes pouring in following passing of beloved Longford newspaper editor
item.description: Tributes are pouring in for the late Derek Cobbe, remembered as a man who "revolutionised regional newspapers." Formerly of Rialto, Dublin, he was the former editor of the Longford Leader and owner of the Longford News. Cobbe was renowned locally and nationally for his 'Uncle Larry' children's column, which became one of the longest running children's pages in a newspaper. item.title: Uisce Éireann working to repair burst water main in Cloonfad
item.description: Uisce Éireann is working to repair a burst water main which is causing supply disruptions to Cloonfad in Co. Roscommon. While some water outages are also being reported in Castlerea. Water tankers are available at Cloonfad National School until 6pm this evening. Uisce Éireann says it is working to ensure alternative drinking water supplies are provided and are urging the public to boil water from tankers before use. Advertisement

item.title: Longford salons found to offer cheapest haircuts in the region
item.description: Hairdressers are expected to increase their prices, with counties Roscommon, Cavan and Monaghan found to be the most expensive in the region for a men's cut. item.title: Man (40s) dies following two-vehicle collision in Co. Cavan
item.description: Gardaí are appealing for witnesses following a fatal road traffic collision that occurred in Shercock Co. Cavan on Monday 2nd February 2026. Shortly before 7:30am Emergency Services and Gardaí responded to a collision involving a car and a lorry on the R192 at Corcloughan, Shercock. The driver of the car, a male in his 40s, was pronounced deceased at the scene a short time later. The lorry driver, a male in his 60s, was taken to hospital for assessment.
